Name: ScriptCheckGridIrregularCode
Content:
<![CDATA[
function CheckGridIrregularCode(v) {
  var s = '\'`~!@#$%^&*(),;"<>?/\\,_', e = false;
  if (v.length > 0) {
    if (v[0] == ' ') e = true;
    else {
      for (var j = 0; j < v.length; j++) {
        if (s.indexOf(v[j]) >= 0) {
          e = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return !e;
}
]]>

  return
end
